rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: When creating a multi-item quote, clicking 'Add Another Item' resets the form to initial state. The original code only preserved customer info (customer_id, customer_name, contact_person, quote_date) but not quote-level data like quantity_breaks. This caused quantity_breaks to be reset to empty array [] after each line item was added.
reproduction_steps: 4. Fill in first line item with part description and quantity
7. Click 'Add Another Item' - quantity breaks are reset to empty
9. Click 'Create Multi-Item Quote' - quote is saved with empty quantity_breaks
rca_of_the_issue.mitigation: Modified the form reset logic in handleAddLineItem() to preserve quantity_breaks and show_quantity_breaks along with customer info
